scope: Offline final-package diffuse previews; no game rendering or cloth solver
reviewed: LOD0 native run, bow and riding worst-frame previews
findings: Eye UV now separates pupil, iris and sclera.
Head, hair and glasses share 1.12 scale. Shoes retain length and height at 0.85 width.
Layered torso clothing and foot surfaces retained across all LODs; aggressive collapse rejected after visual review.
No obvious skin exposure through pants in reviewed riding pose.
limitations: Preview uses decoded final diffuse and quantized skin weights, not the Bannerlord renderer.
Game body sliders, gripping, IK and horse collision remain for user testing.
